payload.rationale: Hard-gate failure (id_integrity): /inputs/plan_candidate/plan_package/architecture/options/*/risks contain free-text risk descriptions that the validator expects to resolve to canonical risk IDs in the risk_register. Repair requires editing the locked canonical section /architecture/options and (to do it properly) either minting new risk IDs for the option-specific risks or restructuring the schema to allow inline risks—both are out of scope for this role (no ID minting; should not edit /architecture/options).
